# caddy_cloth — realism QA repair

Blue folded towel plus distinct pale sage drape; source folds not completely recovered.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f0168, f0008, f0194. Mean silhouette IoU 0.6514. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/caddy_cloth_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/caddy_cloth/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=C, proportions=C, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=C

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Replaced stacked solid rectangular layers with rumpled textile sheets.
- Added thin sheet contact patches and tentative cloth constitutive parameters.
- Added a separate pale draped-towel variant, replacing the stretched blue mesh.
- Refined blue-cloth pose, yaw and dimensions against calibrated masks.

## Remaining

- Blue-cloth fold layout and occlusion still disagree with the source.
- Pale variant pose and fold shape are approximate and lack an independent per-instance silhouette score.
- No runtime cloth integration; only tentative material model plus rigid fallback.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.

Mean IoU 0.6514 -> 0.8017; same-mask RGB distance 0.4781.

- Preserved colour transforms, glass IOR/optical thickness/absorption and metal anisotropy in portable GLB material extensions; procedural bump/SSS remain renderer-dependent.
- Re-measured source depth with ktools in all three review frames; retained depth/calibration uncertainty.
- Replaced unexplained mass priors with explicit constituent volume × density or textile-area budgets; synchronized part masses and COM metadata.
- Added portable MJCF rigid contacts and checked all convex collision meshes.
- Reconstructed a bounded rest envelope from three source contours, replacing the stacked rectangular folds.
- Removed the contaminated pale-towel texture crop and added a source-guided generated blue terry microtexture.
- Replaced planar block contacts with 260 thin convex surface patches.
- Added an executable coarse membrane FEM scene; pale cloth remains a separate rest-shape variant.

Remaining:

- Reconstructed envelope fits visible boundaries; hidden folds and true sheet topology are not recovered.
- Pale cloth received a 55 mm vertical placement correction and three new calibrated renders; its complete wrapping fold is still inaccurate (C), and it lacks an independent pixel mask. See review/light_cloth_variant_qa.json.
- Mass, friction, restitution and stiffness remain estimates, not measured physical calibration.
- Coarse FEM scene is separate from the detailed GLB; dynamic skinning, bending/tearing and real constitutive calibration remain incomplete.

See model.json physics.mass_budget, simulation/rigid.xml, and (for soft assets) simulation/deformable.xml. Generated microtextures are inferred detail, never source evidence.
